I haven't accepted anything yet. The screen I can read doesn't show what's selected, so I can't check how many contacts "the selected contacts" covers. Accepting needs a count I've checked first, and I don't want to change data blind.

I could re-select to get a count, but that would replace your selection. Tell me which contacts you mean, such as a company's pending contacts or specific people. I'll select them, check the count with you, and then accept.
